heard: A blind space probe navigated millions of miles, alone. NASA launched Deep Space 1 to test risky new technology. It used the first AI to control a ship without humans. A glowing ion engine pushed the craft using xenon gas. Suddenly, its navigation system failed, leaving the probe totally blind. Engineers reprogrammed the science camera to act as a new eye. The hack worked, letting it capture the clearest comet photos in history. Its engine fired for a record 16,000 hours in deep space. A blinded machine navigated millions of miles alone.
